name: smwgraphics-mega-man-2-giant-air-man-stage
title: Mega Man 2 - Giant Air Man Stage (16-bit recolor)
description:
Hey! You remember the 16-bit recolour of the original Air Man Stage? Well now you can have a giant version of it just for your Giant Worlds! It can be combined with the original or it can be separated!

As a bonus, you can also use car graphics from Mega Man X! But that will require some work arounds if you want the original 16-bit recolour in there as well.

Have fun!
